dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-m", "ansible_test"]
explanation: This Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image to match the specified Python version. It copies requirements.txt and installs the detected imports (requests, argcomplete, ansible_test, github) via pip. The working directory is set to /app, and the application code is copied into the container. The default command runs ansible_test module, which is a common entry point for Ansible testing. The requirements.txt lists each import on a separate line as standard for pip.
